notes: Any file type, including zip files, can now be attached to a profile. Files attached to a ticket in the cloud now show in its file list. Fixed the Claude chat box covering the User panel, long ticket subjects, and songs appearing twice in the Artists tab.
mac_notes: Any file type, including zip files, can now be attached to a profile. Files attached to a ticket in the cloud now show in its file list. Fixed the Claude chat box covering the User panel, long ticket subjects, and songs appearing twice in the Artists tab.
